<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: template-task-infinite-loop -->
**Template Task Infinite Loop:** When plan.md includes a JSON task block as a "format example" (template),
prepare_context.py parses it as a real pending task. The agent picks it up
every iteration but can't complete it (it's not a real task), causing an
infinite loop of wasted iterations.

Observed in: comfyprompts — 8 iterations stuck on template task.
  Fix: 1. Template/example task blocks must be inside HTML comments (<!-- -->)
   so the JSON parser doesn't see them
2. OR the template must have "passes": true so it's filtered out
3. prepare_context.py should warn if a task has no meaningful description

<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: repetition-comfyprompts-audit-codebase-state-194-passed-9-f -->
**Repetition Comfyprompts Audit Codebase State 194 Passed 9 F:** Task repeated 9 times without progress in comfyprompts: audit codebase state â€” 194 passed, 9 failed, 6 skipped

Stuck task: audit codebase state â€” 194 passed, 9 failed, 6 skipped

Iterations: 6–14 (run consumed 9 loops with no plan progress).

Observed in: comfyprompts
  Fix: 1. Stop running the same task. After two consecutive iterations with no mark-phase commit, decompose into smaller subtasks in `plan.md` before the next attempt. Stuck task: `audit codebase state â€” 194 passed, 9 failed, 6 skipped`.
2. Inspect the last failing diagnose output (`smart_gate.py --diagnose`) and address the specific error the previous iteration produced — don't restart from scratch.
3. If decomposition isn't possible, escalate to a human. Three failed iterations is the budget; a fourth burns more API spend than rewriting the spec.
4. After applying any of the above, tag the commit message with `<lesson_applied stem='repetition-comfyprompts-audit-codebase-state-194-passed-9-f' how='N' />` where N is the step you used. This is how the corpus learns whether the lesson is actually working (see docs/bridge-protocol.md §4h).

<!-- LESSON_ACTIVE: mark-phase-skipped -->
**Mark Phase Skipped:** The agent frequently completes work and commits but forgets to set
"passes": true in plan.md. This causes the next iteration to re-attempt
the same task, wasting cycles.

Observed in: AngryBirds (1x), DissonantDreams-Unity (1x), EventDesignedLearning (5x), campaign-finance-network (60x), comfyprompts (5x), flavor-network (60x), gym-mouse (32x), mod-my-week-platform (105x), murder-mystery (7x), prediction_betting (4x), ralph-universal (55x), unity-py-sim (16x)
  Fix: 1. PROMPT.md Phase 6 (Mark) must be bold with explicit "CRITICAL" warning
2. Manager review checks if the diff includes a passes:true change in plan.md
3. If the last commit message references a task but plan.md wasn't updated, flag it
